title: Business Central 2025 wave 2 (BC27): New Business Central Themes for Visual Studio Code (Light or Dark)
summary: Business Central 2025 wave 2 introduces two new Visual Studio Code themes (Business Central Light and Business Central Dark) featuring the teal brand color. These themes are included in the AL extension package and can be installed from the pre-release version.
key_points: Two new VS Code themes introduced: Business Central Light and Business Central Dark with teal coloring
Themes are included in the AL .vsix package and accessible via a new Set Color Theme button
Available through pre-release version of AL language extension starting from BC22
Users can further customize theme colors in VS Code user interface settings

quotes.text: We are excited to introduce two new themes: Business Central Light and Business Central Dark.
quotes.why_it_matters: Announces the core feature being released with the new themes

quotes.text: These themes prominently feature our favorite color; teal, and are included in the .vsix package.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains how themes are delivered and their visual design focus
